text:
mike: kicking off — quick review of recurring incident patterns from Oct–Dec. goal: agree owners for top 5 themes and deadlines.
priya: +1. I added the aggregated table to the internal deck: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/recurring-q4 (see slide 4).
dan: top themes from the runbook query: cache eviction regressions, model OOMs during long chats, tokenization parser errors, infra flapping during scale events, and slow DB replicas.
linda: can we separate new regressions vs recurring old ones? we need a baseline window.
sara: I ran the incident-query: 
```sql
SELECT label, count(*) as cnt FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= '2025-10-01' AND created_at <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY label ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
results attached (CSV).
incident-bot: incident-bot: compiled 42 incidents matching "recurring" tag between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31. Top labels: caching(28%), model-oom(19%), db-replica(16%).
mike: propose owners: caching -> @priya, model OOM -> @dan, DB replica -> @alex, tokenizer -> @linda, scale-flapping -> @sara. agree?
priya: ok. I'll create a remediation epic and link the related postmortems. tentative ETA: 2026-01-31 for initial fixes.
dan: model OOM remediation plan: add conservative quantization profile, pin problematic model version, and run a 1-week stress test on the dedicated pool with long-session workloads. I'm owner, ETA 2026-01-20.
alex: db replica plan: add read-fallback logic, stricter statement timeouts, and improve replica monitoring. opening ticket JIRA-9812 with runbook links. ETA 2026-02-05.
linda: tokenizer fixes: add corpus-based fuzz tests and fix whitespace-edge tokenization in tokenizer v4. Will pair with CI infra for integration runner. I own, ETA 2026-01-15.
sara: scale-flapping: seems tied to autoscaler burst policy + transient node preemption. action: temporary shard cap + tighter scale-down cooldowns and add alert on scaling variance. I'll do canary change and monitor. ETA 2026-01-10.
priya: also adding observability: per-route cache hit-rate, prefix KV eviction metric, and alert when eviction rate > 5% in 5m window. cc: @eng-sre for query help.
dan: note — many model OOMs correlate with very long chat sessions. short-term mitigation: enforce per-session token soft-limits and a graceful truncation policy.
mike: action items summary (I will add to the incident tracker): owners, tickets, ETAs, and test plans. please drop final ticket IDs by EOD Friday.
alex: done — JIRA-9812 created and linked.
linda: created JIRA-9827 for tokenizer tests and PR template.
sara: will post canary window + rollout plan in #eng-oncall and tag oncall leads.
priya: scheduling a follow-up sync two weeks after the last ETA to check progress and metrics: proposed 2026-02-10 10:00 PST.
mike: also want a target: 50% drop in recurring incident count vs Q4 baseline by end of Q1; track weekly. everyone ok with that target?
all: :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: reminder set for 2026-02-10 10:00 PST — follow-up sync.
mike: thanks all — I'll close this thread after I add ticket links and the follow-up calendar invite.
